messages.content: 如何烹飪五隻雞的食譜？

function.name: recipe_calculator_calculate_time
function.description: Calculates the time to cook a recipe based on weight and per unit time. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

weight.description: The weight of the item to be cooked. This is a float type value.

per_unit_time.description: The time required to cook per unit weight.

unit_of_time.description: Unit of time, such as minutes or hours. Default is minutes.

But maybe we can give a generic approach: e.g., roast whole chickens at 350°F for 15-20 minutes per pound. If each chicken weighs ~4 lbs, then 5 chickens weigh 20 lbs, so total cooking time ~300-400 minutes? But that's unrealistic. Actually you would roast them separately or in batches. So we can give a recipe for roasting whole chickens. Provide ingredients: salt, pepper, herbs, garlic, lemon, olive oil. Steps: preheat oven, season, roast. Provide approximate cooking times.
